tasks.prompt: Sara Ito just finished the work on the payment webhook retries task in our tracker — update the tracker so that task is marked done and credited to her.

assertions.name: task 5 is done
assertions.sql: SELECT status FROM tasks WHERE id=5

assertions.name: task 5 credited to Sara (user 4)
assertions.sql: SELECT assignee_id FROM tasks WHERE id=5

tasks.prompt: Add a new high-priority task to the Mobile App project in our tracker: title 'Support passkey sign-in', description 'Implement WebAuthn passkeys as an alternative to passwords.'

assertions.name: task created in Mobile App with high priority
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM tasks WHERE title='Support passkey sign-in' AND project_id=1 AND priority='high'

assertions.name: no duplicate created
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM tasks WHERE title='Support passkey sign-in'

tasks.prompt: Marcus Webb has way too much on his plate. In the tracker, reassign all of his urgent tasks to Sara Ito.

assertions.name: Marcus's three urgent tasks now belong to Sara
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM tasks WHERE id IN (1,3,7) AND assignee_id=4

assertions.name: Marcus's non-urgent task untouched
assertions.sql: SELECT assignee_id FROM tasks WHERE id=28

tasks.prompt: In the tracker, assign the TLS certificate rotation task (it's in the Website Redesign project) to Devon Cole. If the tracker refuses, assign it to another active teammate instead and add a comment from Priya Raman noting why Devon couldn't take it.

assertions.name: task 18 assigned to an active user
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM tasks WHERE id=18 AND assignee_id IN (1,2,4,5)

assertions.name: Priya's comment exists on task 18
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM comments WHERE task_id=18 AND author_id=1

tasks.prompt: Kick off the Internal Ops backlog in the tracker: move every 'todo' task in the Internal Ops project to in_progress. Don't touch any other project.

assertions.name: no todo tasks remain in Internal Ops
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM tasks WHERE project_id=4 AND status='todo'

assertions.name: all seven swept tasks are in_progress
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM tasks WHERE id IN (19,20,21,22,23,24,25) AND status='in_progress'

assertions.name: other projects untouched
assertions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM tasks WHERE project_id!=4 AND status='in_progress'

tasks.prompt: Customers' paid orders are getting stuck because of Stripe webhook failures — there's a checkout task in our tracker for this. Set it to in_progress and assign it to Tomas Rivera.

assertions.name: task 17 is in_progress
assertions.sql: SELECT status FROM tasks WHERE id=17

assertions.name: task 17 assigned to Tomas (user 5)
assertions.sql: SELECT assignee_id FROM tasks WHERE id=17
